dog.description_text:
Meet Rudy

Rudy is a little fighter who has already been through more than any puppy should.

Rudy came to us from Georgia while he was struggling with parvo, a serious and heartbreaking illness that can be especially dangerous for young puppies. He was fighting to get through each day, and all we wanted was to give this sweet boy the chance he deserved.

Rudy fought hard.

Now, we want to make sure that all of that fighting leads somewhere beautiful. We want Rudy to know what it feels like to simply be a puppy. To have a family who loves him, a soft place to sleep, toys to play with, and people who will be there for him through all of life's little adventures.

He has already shown us just how strong he can be. Now he needs someone who will show him how wonderful life can be.

Please adopt Rudy. Give this little fighter the forever home he has worked so hard to reach. He deserves a family who will cherish him, love him, and make sure the rest of his story is filled with happiness.Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. They are meant to give you a glimpse into their personality and story, but there is so much more to learn. Please reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Rudy and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
